findings.message: CRITICAL: Trace granularity mismatch. The AC document contains a detailed Traceability Matrix (lines 234-258) that claims specific FR/NFR/RULE references for each AC (e.g., AC-1 derives from FR-2, NFR-2; AC-2 derives from FR-1, FR-8, RULE-3; etc.), but the actual trace graph only contains coarse-grained traces from AC-9 to the parent documents (UC-6, UC-7, UC-8, FR-3, NFR-4, RULE-5). The individual FR/NFR/RULE items mentioned in the AC documentation are not reflected in the actual trace graph. Each AC must have specific derived_from traces to the exact FR/NFR/RULE items it references.
